image_description: A museum-style display featuring three firearms mounted on a white wall. The central and most prominent firearm is a black assault rifle (resembling an AK-variant) with a wooden stock and handguard, equipped with a large drum or high-capacity magazine. Above it is a yellow/orange training cutaway model of a similar weapon. Below it is another assault rifle with wood furniture. Informational placards are visible next to the weapons.

The yellow object lacks internal mechanical logic; the trigger group and magazine area appear fused and structurally nonsensical compared to a real cutaway model.
The wood grain texture is slightly smudged and lacks the sharp micro-detail of real varnished wood, appearing somewhat painted-on.

However, it fails specific taxonomy checkpoints regarding 'polymer furniture' (it uses wood) and 'Picatinny rail/carrying handle' (it uses a smooth dust cover), indicating a mismatch with the specific textual definition provided despite being a valid assault rifle.
